domains.title: Sensitive Data Element Remediation
domains.purpose: Plan a scoped remediation for secrets, tokens, PII, PCI, PHI, or internal identifiers found in current source, logs, configs, schemas, fixtures, and IaC.
inputs: secret scanning, DLP, or SDE finding payload
approved secret store or redaction helper
allowed_actions: replace a literal with an approved secret-store reference
redact or hash a field through an existing helper
drop an accidental field from a log or fixture
write a rotation and disclosure triage note for exposed material
stop_conditions: finding is already exposed in history, public logs, or released artifacts
fix requires database, public API, or privacy-design changes
no approved secret store, redaction helper, or scanner replay exists
outputs: TRIAGE.md rotation packet for exposed data
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to choose between redact, hash, drop, gate, or triage after deterministic scanner evidence is normalized. Never ask it to reason over raw secret values.

domains.title: Vulnerable Dependency Remediation
domains.purpose: Convert SCA, CVE, OSV, Dependabot, or SBOM dependency findings into one lockfile-safe remediation run or a bounded triage note.
inputs: CVE, GHSA, OSV, or vendor advisory
package ecosystem and current resolved version
allowed_actions: select the lowest safe patched version
plan package-manager-native lockfile updates
separate direct and transitive remediation paths
route major-version or no-fix advisories to triage
stop_conditions: patched version crosses a direct dependency major boundary
affected package is not present in the lockfile
advisory is malicious-package rollback rather than forward bump
tests or package-manager resolution cannot be reproduced
outputs: triage note for major, transitive, yanked, or no-fix cases
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to explain the reviewer risk and draft PR body language after deterministic advisory and resolver checks choose the version.

domains.title: SAST Finding Remediation
domains.purpose: Plan a narrow, testable fix for first-party code findings where source, sink, rule, and safe pattern are known.
inputs: rule id, source, sink, path, and line
allowed_actions: apply one approved sanitizer, validator, encoder, authorization, or parser-hardening pattern
add a regression test that fails before the fix
write a triage note when data flow is ambiguous
stop_conditions: finding spans multiple services or trust boundaries
fix requires architecture, auth model, schema, or product behavior changes
scanner result lacks source, sink, rule, or reproducible path
evidence: test proving the vulnerable path is closed
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to map the scanner rule to a safe local pattern and draft test cases. Do not let it invent a sanitizer when the repo lacks one.

domains.title: Base Image and Container Layer Remediation
domains.purpose: Plan updates for vulnerable base images, OS packages, Dockerfiles, and derived image rebuilds without broad deployment changes.
inputs: image reference, digest, Dockerfile, or SBOM
allowed_actions: select patched tag or digest from approved base-image policy
plan a Dockerfile or lockstep manifest update
require image rebuild, rescan, and startup smoke test
split curated-base and downstream-refresh work
stop_conditions: image is built outside the repo
base image is not on the approved publisher list
fix requires production rollout, migration, or runtime privilege changes
scanner cannot rescan the rebuilt image
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to explain blast radius and draft operator notes after scanner and registry data have selected an approved tag or digest.

domains.title: Artifact Cache and Mirror Quarantine
domains.purpose: Plan quarantine, deny-listing, and cache purge activity for compromised packages, images, mirrors, build caches, and CI artifacts.
allowed_actions: identify exact artifact coordinates
plan deny-list, mirror removal, and cache invalidation
produce consumer impact list
separate purge from dependency or image remediation
stop_conditions: artifact identity is range-based or ambiguous
registry operation would delete audit evidence
consumer inventory is missing
purge requires production outage or customer-impacting action
evidence: artifact name, version, digest, and source advisory
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to draft stakeholder communication and consumer impact summaries. Never use it as the source of truth for what to delete.

domains.title: Recipe Recommender
domains.purpose: Classify one finding, pick one safest recipe, and write the handoff contract before a remediation agent starts.
inputs: scanner alert, ticket, advisory, or SARIF snippet
allowed_actions: normalize a finding into routing fields
score candidate recipes
select one recipe or triage
write a downstream agent handoff
stop_conditions: top recipe score is weak
finding spans multiple repos, owners, or services
required evidence would change the route but is missing
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to summarize messy finding text. Keep scoring deterministic and require a single selected route.

domains.title: Gatekeeping Patterns
domains.purpose: Evaluate whether a remediation run should be admitted, held mid-run, allowed to open a PR, or blocked before merge.
allowed_actions: evaluate admission, mid-run, pre-merge, and post-merge gates
produce allow, hold, deny, or triage decision
attach reviewer and evidence requirements
stop_conditions: workflow id is unknown
agent identity or authorization is missing
requested action exceeds the recipe scope
required reviewer gate is not configured
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to explain the decision in human language after deterministic policy evaluation returns allow, hold, deny, or triage.

domains.title: Runtime Controls
domains.purpose: Plan scoped runtime controls for agent sessions, tool calls, telemetry, disablement, and active remediation boundaries.
allowed_actions: define session scope and tool allowlist
plan telemetry and kill-switch checks
recommend hold conditions for abnormal tool use
produce runtime evidence requirements
stop_conditions: write-capable tool lacks explicit scope
telemetry cannot identify agent, workflow, and run
egress or identity boundary is unowned
runtime action would impact production without approval
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to summarize telemetry anomalies, not to approve tool calls. Policy remains deterministic.

domains.title: Classic Vulnerable Defaults
domains.purpose: Plan repeatable fixes for unsafe parser, deserialization, crypto, JWT, XML, HTTP client, shell, or framework defaults.
allowed_actions: map pattern to an approved safe default
add regression tests for unsafe input
preserve behavior for legitimate inputs
stop when compatibility risk is broad
stop_conditions: no approved safe replacement exists
fix changes public behavior without owner approval
callsite is generated, vendored, or shared across unrelated flows
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to identify local helper conventions and draft compatibility tests. Do not let it invent a new cryptographic policy.

domains.title: Crypto Payments Security
domains.purpose: Plan remediation for wallet, address integrity, settlement, custody, payment finality, nonce, and irreversible transaction workflows.
inputs: asset, chain, wallet, or processor context
allowed_actions: plan validation for address, chain, amount, and replay controls
separate code fix from treasury or custody operations
require sandbox or testnet proof
route key or funds movement to human incident response
stop_conditions: fix requires moving funds, rotating custody keys, or touching production wallets
chain, asset, or processor ownership is unclear
no sandbox or testnet verification path exists
evidence: operator actions excluded from agent scope
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to draft reviewer notes and threat-model questions. Never let it propose or execute funds movement.

domains.title: DeFi and Blockchain Protocol Security
domains.purpose: Plan remediation for smart contracts, protocol upgrades, bridges, oracles, governance, multisig, and blockchain-specific controls.
inputs: chain, contract, bridge, oracle, or governance context
allowed_actions: plan code-level contract remediation and invariant tests
require simulation before upgrade
separate governance proposal from code patch
document timelock and signer requirements
stop_conditions: remediation requires emergency pause, upgrade execution, or signer action
economic assumptions are disputed
contract ownership or upgradeability is unclear
simulation path is missing
evidence: unit, fuzz, invariant, or fork simulation result
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to summarize protocol context and review risks after static analysis and simulations define the safe patch.

domains.title: Program Metrics and KPIs
domains.purpose: Build a measurement packet for agent-assisted remediation quality, speed, reviewer load, false positives, and automation ROI.
allowed_actions: normalize run, PR, scanner, and review facts
compute queue, quality, and reviewer metrics
separate automation wins from hidden human work
produce dashboard-ready JSON
stop_conditions: run id cannot be joined to PR or finding id
metric would encourage unsafe auto-merge behavior
data source omits failed or triaged runs
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to narrate metric changes for leadership. Do not use it to compute or alter source metrics.

domains.title: Reviewer Playbook
domains.purpose: Prepare a reviewer checklist and evidence packet for a security PR or triage note produced by an agent.
allowed_actions: check recipe scope against diff
summarize evidence and missing proof
list reviewer questions
recommend approve, request changes, or triage
stop_conditions: diff touches files outside recipe scope
tests, scanner rerun, or run receipt is missing
agent made hidden infrastructure, credential, or production changes
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to summarize long diffs and draft reviewer questions. Keep final approval human-owned.

domains.title: Rollout and Maturity Model
domains.purpose: Plan crawl, walk, run adoption for agent-assisted remediation with promotion criteria, controls, and stop signals.
allowed_actions: score readiness by domain
recommend next maturity stage
define promotion and rollback criteria
attach control gaps and owner actions
stop_conditions: no reviewer capacity for the proposed stage
tool access is broader than workflow scope
metrics do not include failed and triaged runs
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to translate technical readiness gaps into program milestones. Do not let it waive controls.

domains.title: Compliance and Audit
domains.purpose: Map remediation runs to audit-ready evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST SSDF, internal controls, and customer diligence.
allowed_actions: map a run to controls and evidence
produce auditor-facing narrative
separate proof from model transcript
identify missing retention or approval artifacts
stop_conditions: run receipt is missing identity, tool, or approval data
control mapping would expose sensitive source or secrets
evidence is unverifiable or retained only in ephemeral chat
domains.llm_assist: Use the LLM to draft control narratives from retained evidence. Do not send source code, secrets, or private findings outside the approved boundary.
